show: „Starzyński” (Teatr Syrena, Warszawa; autorska premiera musicalowa Teatru Syrena). VERIFIED FACTS about this production — the synopsis must not contradict any of them: (1) 🚨 The action takes place on the evening, night and morning of 26 and 27 OCTOBER 1939 — never 1941. These are Starzyński's last hours in Warsaw's city hall under German occupation. (2) Official facts: battered Warsaw, boundless helplessness, remorse, sadness and moral dilemmas; outside there are ruins, autumn, the approaching Zaduszki (All Souls') and darkness; ghosts crawl out of memories and dream mixes with waking. (3) Official cast: Stefan Starzyński, Stefania Witkowska/Syrena/Reklamiara, Adam Brodziński, Stanisław Lorentz, Władysław Studnicki, Matka, Ojciec/Józef Piłsudski, Józia, Sylwester Wojewódzki/Lech Niemojewski, Paulina/Ludwika Nitschowa, Żołnierz Gestapo. (4) The production uses fragments of Adam Mickiewicz's 'Dziady', quotations from Starzyński's own speeches, and Ludwika Nitschowa's words from Polish Radio reportage. It is inspired by Grzegorz Piątek's biography 'Starzyński. Prezydent z pomnika'.
synopsis:
斯特凡·斯塔任斯基独坐在被占领的华沙市政厅里，窗外是瓦砾、深秋、将临的万灵节与浓得化不开的黑暗。1939年10月26日傍晚，他在一夜未眠中面对满目疮痍的城市，也面对自己是否尽力守护了华沙的追问；德国占领下的无边无力感、悔恨、悲伤与道德困境，一层层逼近。

秘书斯特凡妮娅·维特科夫斯卡、亚当·布罗津斯基、斯坦尼斯瓦夫·洛伦茨、瓦迪斯瓦夫·斯图德尼茨基等现实中的来访者与同僚，牵动他对责任、妥协与抵抗的反复权衡。母亲、父亲与约瑟夫·毕苏斯基、约齐娅、西尔韦斯特·沃耶武茨基、保利娜及卢德维卡·尼奇霍娃等身影亦自记忆深处浮现；城市人鱼、广告女郎和盖世太保士兵，则令现实更加诡谲不安。

夜色中，梦境与清醒彼此渗透，亡灵般的记忆涌出；人物的声音与斯塔任斯基昔日演说的回响交错，并融入密茨凯维奇《先人祭》的片段及尼奇霍娃的广播报道言辞。

10月27日清晨到来时，他仍须在无法挽回的现实中作出选择。全剧将一位抵抗象征还原为一个承受恐惧、内疚与责任的人，并让华沙的创伤在他的最后一夜里发出回声。

show: 忍劇「NARUTO-ナルト-」(2027年2月〜 京都・南座;原作 岸本斉史;演出 植木豪;構成 亀田真二郎). VERIFIED FACTS about this production — the synopsis must not contradict any of them: (1) 🚨 This production is a NON-VERBAL ninja live show ('ノンバーバル忍者ライブショー'): no dialogue and no songs. It uses actors' action, acrobatics and aerial work fused with projection mapping and illusion, plus all the stage machinery of the kabuki theatre Minamiza. (2) 🚨 The only plot statement the producers make is that it depicts the story of the NARUTO boyhood arc (少年篇), in which Naruto Uzumaki grows up together with his companions in the Hidden Leaf Village. Do NOT retell specific manga arcs — no source says this show stages the Land of Waves, Zabuza and Haku, the Chūnin Exams, Mizuki, Iruka or the Scroll of Sealing. (3) Official characters announced: Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Sakura Haruno, Kakashi Hatake. Do not introduce others by name. (4) 🚨 Never write a sentence about what 'the official production identifies' or about sources, adaptations or versions. Describe only what happens. (5) It is acceptable for this synopsis to be shorter than usual, because very little plot detail has been published.
synopsis:
木叶隐村的晨光掠过屋檐，漩涡鸣人以不服输的身影穿行其间，向着成为独当一面的忍者不断迈进。这个总会惹出骚动的少年，心中却有着强烈的渴望：希望被村里的人认可，也希望证明自己并非只能孤身前行。忍术训练、突发任务与伙伴间的较量，让他的成长之路充满跌倒后再度跃起的时刻。

春野樱敏锐而坚定，在队伍中努力寻找自己的位置；宇智波佐助拥有出众实力，也背负着难以言明的孤傲与目标。三人从彼此陌生、争执不断，到在一次次并肩行动中逐渐理解对方的长处与脆弱。旗木卡卡西则带领他们接受严格磨炼，使他们明白忍者的力量不仅来自技巧，更来自信任、协作与守护同伴的意志。

随着挑战接连袭来，鸣人必须面对自己的冲动与不安，也要学会把个人的愿望放进伙伴共同前行的道路之中。飞跃、追逐、交锋与险境交织成热烈的忍者旅程，少年们在木叶的天空下不断突破极限。

鸣人、佐助与小樱在成长中彼此碰撞，也彼此支撑。每一次携手迎向困难，都让他们离真正的忍者之路更近一步。

show: „A Charlie Brown Christmas: Live on Stage” (touring stage production adapted from Charles M. Schulz; music by Vince Guaraldi). VERIFIED FACTS about this production — the synopsis must not contradict any of them: (1) 🚨 Charlie Brown is asked to direct the NEIGHBORHOOD Christmas play — not a school play. The official touring copy says the Peanuts gang 'produce their own Christmas play and ultimately learn the true meaning of the season'. (2) 🚨 Linus's speech is the turning point of the work and must appear: when Charlie Brown asks whether anyone knows what Christmas is all about, Linus steps into the spotlight and answers. (3) Officially named characters: Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Lucy, Linus, and 'the whole Peanuts gang'. Lucy runs her own five-cent psychiatric booth — Charlie Brown pays her for advice; she does not set it up for him. (4) 🚨 Do NOT include Peppermint Patty: she first appeared in 1966, after the 1965 work this show adapts. Sally, Schroeder, Violet, Frieda and Patty are safer, but the official copy names only Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Lucy and Linus — keep other names to a minimum. (5) Other canonical beats: Snoopy decorates his doghouse for the lights-and-display contest; Charlie Brown chooses a small bare tree instead of a shiny aluminium one; the others mock it, then restore it together. Music by Vince Guaraldi.
synopsis:
圣诞将至，查理·布朗被伙伴们推举为社区圣诞剧的导演，却始终觉得满城的彩灯、礼物与热闹让节日失去了应有的温度。史努比忙着把狗屋装饰得华丽夺目，参加灯饰展示比赛；露西则守在五分钱心理咨询摊前，查理·布朗付钱向她倾诉自己的困惑，却没能得到真正的答案。

为了替圣诞剧找到合适的布景和象征，查理·布朗顶着众人的不解，放弃闪亮的铝制圣诞树，选中一棵瘦小、光秃而低垂的小树。他希望借此唤回节日更朴素的意义，却反而遭到伙伴们嘲笑，连原本的演出也似乎难以继续。

失落的查理·布朗向大家问道：究竟谁知道圣诞节真正意味着什么？此时，莱纳斯走到聚光灯下，平静地说出自己的答案。他的话让喧闹的伙伴们安静下来，也令查理·布朗重新理解了圣诞节所指向的善意、希望与彼此关怀。

最终，孩子们不再嫌弃那棵小树，而是一起为它添上装饰、扶正枝干。随着文斯·瓜拉尔迪的音乐响起，原先各自追逐热闹与炫耀的伙伴，终于共同完成了属于他们的圣诞剧。
